segments.text: All mankind being thus fallen, and become altogether dead in ſinnes and treſpaſſes, and ſubject to the eternall wrath of the great God by tranſgreſſion; yet the elect, which God hath loved with an everlaſting love, are redeemed, quickned, and ſaved, not by themſelves, neither by their own workes, leſt any man ſhould boaſt himſelfe, but wholly and onely by God of his free grace and mercie through Jeſus Chriſt, who of God is made unto us wiſdome, righteouſneſſe, ſanctification and redemption, that as it is written, Hee that rejoyceth, let him rejoyce in the Lord.
